The draft corrects the plan’s claim that a 304 confirms all selectors remain valid: HTTP validator results are separate from local passage and extraction state ([RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html), [Web Annotation](https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-annotation-model-20170223/)). Validation cases are proposals; no handbook, crawler, live freshness check, or test suite was run.
